correctness.rationale: Using the exact two-row Monge vertex classes from Erickson–Kretschmann Proposition 5.1, support is H_n=max{max_j (G_1j+G_2j)/2, all top-row suffix and bottom-row prefix Gaussian averages}. Column maxima T_n use iid N(0,1/2) with b_n satisfying n barPhi(sqrt2 b_n)=1. For k>=2 row averages N(0,1/k), Gaussian tail bounds at 0.9b_n make their expected excess negligible on the n^−1/2(log n)^−3/4 scale. Removing two correlated boundary columns costs O(1/(nb_n)), after which exactly two independent N(0,1) row singleton exceedances contribute 2I_n~π^(1/4)/(sqrt(n)b_n^(3/2)). Change t=b_n+x/(2b_n), dominated Mills asymptotics, Γ(1/2)=sqrtπ establish constant; Gaussian polar formula w=2 E h/m_{2n−1}, m~sqrt(2n) yields limit sqrt2 π^(1/4). Maximum has standard Gumbel limit. Independence approximation is controlled, not assumed. Finite support LP examples do not prove the limiting constant; the proof is Gaussian analysis.
